hypothesis: A mature balanced auction has directional edge only after a failed boundary auction (spring or UTAD), a later lower-volume test that holds the extreme, and a confirming directional bar while entry remains near that boundary.
difference_from_s90_s92: S90-S92 reacted to a single level or reclaim. S94 requires a multi-day range, separated touches on both sides, a prior trend, an absorption event, a distinct test and a distinct confirmation in causal order.

data.source: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m kline and actual funding archives
data.execution: first actual 1m open after the confirming 1h close

range.boundaries: 10th percentile of lows and 90th percentile of highs, frozen before sweep

risk.target: opposite range boundary minus 0.10 ATR buffer

prospective_gate: Later of 180 days, 100 fills and 60 independent event clusters for validation, followed by the same untouched evaluation requirement.
claim_policy: All data before prospective_t0 is contaminated development. Passing historical gates permits paper-forward only and never guarantees profit.
